sloka: स विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दुर्धरं चैव राक्षसम् ।प्रघसं भारकर्णं च पञ्च सेनाग्रनायकान् ।। ५.४६.२।।।।
transliteration: sa virūpākṣayūpākṣau durdharaṁ caiva rākṣasam ।praghasaṁ bhārakarṇaṁ ca pañca senāgranāyakān ।। 5.46.2।।।।

translations.english: The tenheaded Ravana, eager to capture Hanuman, commanded his five army Generals called Virupaksha, Yupaksha, Durdhara, Praghasa and Bhaskarna, who were great warriorstatesmen valiant and, equal to wind in speed.
translations.hindi: वह हनुमानजी का तेजःपुञज शरीर देख मन ही मन शंकित हो सोचने लगा कि, कहीं ये साक्षात्‌ भगवान्‌ नन्दी तो यहाँ नहीं श्रा गए
